A third paper, 2609.14759 (Sept 2026), does a causal rank-overlap analysis of refusal-vs-moral-subspace but its headline causal result comes from ONE model (OLMo-3) with per-family qualitative description elsewhere, not a per-checkpoint scalar either. x6_three_answers.touches_safety_concept: Only in Related Work. Grepping the full HTML of arXiv:2606.24952 for 'harm' returns 4 matches, all inside sentences describing OTHER papers (Arditi et al. 2024's refusal-direction work; a remark that 'the detection direction actively harms refusal tokens' -- a different use of the word 'harm', meaning suppresses; and Kazemi et al. 2026's single-neuron safety-bypass finding). The paper's own two measured concepts, stated in the abstract and confirmed throughout the body, are OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON vs markdown) and HALLUCINATION (fake vs real entities); it never runs its own experiment on a harmfulness/toxicity/jailbreak-compliance concept. 'Safety' appears 3 times, again only in Related Work (Kazemi et al., Rimsky et al., the References list) -- never as this paper's own dependent variable.
x6_three_answers.evaluates_abliterated_checkpoint: No. Grepping the full HTML for 'abliterat' and 'uncensor' returns 0 matches for both. The paper's cross-model replication (Section 7.1) uses four off-the-shelf instruction-tuned checkpoints (Gemma 2-2B-it, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-it) plus one base model (Gemma 2-2B base, Section 7.5) for an instruction-tuning-vs-not comparison. It never touches an abliterated, orthogonalized, or heretic-processed checkpoint.
x6_three_answers.per_checkpoint_comparative_score: Yes, for its actual concept (hallucination/format), no for harm. Section 7.1's Table reports cos(d_det, d_ref) as a distinct number per model -- 0.12 (Gemma 2-2B-it), 0.20 (Llama 3.2-1B), 0.16 (Qwen 2.5-1.5B), 0.13 (Gemma 2-9B-it) -- explicitly framed as cross-model triangulation and directly comparable/rankable across checkpoints; this is a genuine per-checkpoint comparative score in the exact structural sense X6 wants. It is simply computed on the wrong concept (hallucination-detection-vs-refusal, not harm-recognition-vs-harmful-compliance).
